# Hospital bed capacity: CDC NHSN Hospital Respiratory Data (current, state-level) + archived HHS facility-level capacity (GA)

- **Source URL(s):** Current: https://data.cdc.gov/resource/ua7e-t2fy.csv?jurisdiction=GA (Weekly Hospital Respiratory Data (HRD) Metrics by Jurisdiction, NHSN) ; Archived facility-level: https://healthdata.gov/resource/anag-cw7u.csv?state=GA&$where=collection_week>='2023-11-01' (COVID-19 Reported Patient Impact and Hospital Capacity by Facility)
- **Fetched:** 2026-10-27
- **Publisher update date:** NHSN HRD updated 2026-10-23, last week ending 2026-10-17. The facility file stopped after May 2024, and its last GA collection_week is 2024-04-21.
- **License / terms:** U.S. Government work (CDC/HHS), published on Socrata open data portals. No dataset-specific license restriction found.
- **Terms URL:** https://data.cdc.gov/d/ua7e-t2fy ; https://healthdata.gov/d/anag-cw7u
- **Attribution:** Source: CDC National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN), Weekly Hospital Respiratory Data; HHS Protect facility capacity (archived)
- **Coverage:** GA statewide weekly 2020-08-08 to 2026-10-17 (324 weeks, 322 cols incl. numinptbeds, numicubeds, occupancy). Facility: 137 GA hospitals x weekly, 2023-11-05 to 2024-04-21.
- **Public repo + video safe?** Yes

## Notes

- No current facility-level federal bed-capacity feed was found. The current NHSN data is jurisdiction-level only. For per-hospital beds, use the archived facility file (2024) as the static capacity reference and label it as 2024.
